facts.text: Sense Ortho Ultra Mattress - Ivory White.
Selected variant: Queen / 72 x 60 (183 cm x 152 cm) / 8 (20.3cm).
Sense Ortho Ultra has an 8-inch mattress with cool-to-touch high-GSM knit fabric cover, BodyIQ orthopedic memory foam layer, and firm orthopedic base foam.
With a thicker layer of BodyIQ memory foam that intuitively adapts to every body curve (and yes, zero motion transfer), this mattress makes every sleep feel customized.
Beneath the memory foam, a smart profile foam layer with egg tray structure keeps airflow flowing and pressure points zeroed out.
The firm base layer offers deep orthopedic support and better posture alignment through the night.
